verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://docs.helix-db.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The documented HTTP API contract (POST /v2/query, shared by the local server and the Cloud gateway) is the surface such a spec would describe. Missing for 10: no first-party docs describing the spec or what it covers, and no confirmation that it fully covers the query and Cloud admin endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.helix-db.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The HelixDB HTTP API accepts operation-tree queries at `POST /v2/query`. The same contract is available from a local server and a Helix Cloud gateway.
